cohort: 1,439,977 nulliparous women with term, singleton, vertex pregnancies from the 2013 U.S. National Vital Statistics Report.
finding: Even after controlling for maternal, sociodemographic, and obstetric comorbidities, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy remained an independent risk factor for cesarean delivery in nulliparous women at term.
mod_finding: Women with hypertensive disorders of pregnancy had a higher cesarean delivery rate compared to women without, even after controlling for other risk factors.
